checks: Only batch.tar.gz and PREPARED.json are permitted; each file is bounded to128MiB, chunks to300000 raw bytes and each emitted base64 piece to50000 characters.
Plan pins source file identity, byte length, chunk hashes and full hash. Emit checks source identity before/after the bounded read and verifies the chunk bytes.
Plan hash and canonical fixed Mac base/build/batch paths are validated before incoming/destination use. Existing destinations and output files are not overwritten.
Assembly requires exact incoming membership, rejects invalid/symlink chunks, verifies encoded/decoded length and chunk SHA, writes files exclusively, and checks whole output SHA/length.
Partial failure leaves incomplete files, cannot produce durable acceptance, and cannot be blindly retried over an existing destination.
Successful transport explicitly remains NOT_VERIFIED_NOT_DURABLE. Reviewed exporterba0c33df independently verifies arrival semantics and fsyncs durable storage.
Synthetic fixture loader executes tool source bytes directly; six owner-reported fixtures and Python3.8 syntax check were inspected, not rerun by reviewer.
operational_limits: Root must approve the concrete archive/PREPARED hashes, actual build ID and batch number, destination and previous durable pointer before real transfer. This static receipt does not approve a future plan.
The helper does not compare transport build/batch labels with the PREPARED snapshot; concrete plan review must check that equality.

After partial assembly, the same numbered destination is intentionally unavailable without a separate reviewed recovery/quarantine action. Do not treat a new incoming UUID as permission to overwrite a partial final directory.
One coordinator owns each incoming directory; uncertain append results must be inspected by encoded length and decoded hash, never blindly repeated.
Runtime/source/build/Git mutation, actual capture or transport, and proof acceptance were not performed by this reviewer.
